answer: Reaching eligibility takes 65 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone burns for every seat it wants. The harbor register is checked at draw time, vault lists the eligible set, and meadow seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 65 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 116 account operation therefore ties up 32 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
